span.p:
PHASE 1 – PROJECT SETUP
Thiết lập dự án
Project Information – Lead/Checker • Scope Check – Lead/Checker • Scope Boundary • Input Documents • Latest Information Check • Contract Review by Detailer • Trace Design Intent • Document Conflict Check

div.style: color: rgb(107, 78, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PHASE 2 – MODELING
Dựng Model
Model Setup • Architecture Check • Structure Check • Terminal Unit / Diffuser Check • Equipment Check • Routing Strategy • Supply Air Duct • Return Air Duct • Exhaust Air Duct • Outside Air / Relief Air Duct • Kitchen / Grease Exhaust Duct • Fire / Smoke Damper & Life Safety • Duct Insulation & Liner • Terminal Box Connections – VAV/FCU/CAV
(see detailed diagram below)

color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PHASE 3 – ENGINEERING & SUPPORTS
Kỹ thuật & Giá đỡ
Access / Maintenance • Insulation • Hanger / Support • Penetration Strategy • Deck / Floor Sleeve • Wall / Roof Sleeve / Opening • Core Drill • Deck Insert

Phối hợp
Elevation Check • Coordination • Customer Issue / RFI • Customer Response

color: rgb(18, 59, 94) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Trimble / Layout hiện trường
Trimble / Field Layout Point • Roof / Wall Curb & Penetration Layout • Terminal Unit Rough-In • Field Layout Release • Pour Schedule Control

Chế tạo Duct
Duct Fabrication Ready • Duct Ticket Planning / Break • Field Connection • Duct Shop Ticket / Drawing • Duct Ticket Dimension • Duct Fabrication QC / Release

BOM / Báo cáo
BOM – Bill of Materials • Pending / Hold Register • Superseded File Control

Bản vẽ Shop Duct
IFR → Customer Comments → IFA → Approval Response → IFC → PDF/Filename/Transmittal → Shop Sleeve

QC / Rà soát cuối
Constructability • Detailer Self-Check • Checker QC • QC Comment Update • Revision Impact • Field Feedback • Final Closeout • FINAL SIGN-OFF – DETAILER • FINAL SIGN-OFF – LEAD/CHECKER
(see detailed diagram below)
